design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (rental_property_renewals_and_cancellations, M=2). Draw (draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[5, 5, 6, 5]. Assignment (round 2): re-rating correction 5, late-billed installment 5, upgrade difference 6, sale cancellation credit 5.

1. WHY A GOOD TEST. Thaddeus Okonkwo-Lindqvist asks only to confirm the cancellation of his sold rental's contract with the credit for the unused part of the month. The credit waits on the installment for the notice period (never billed); the confirmation waits on the late-August upgrade's charge (never billed); the installment waits on correcting the July and August installments that were re-rated to 0.00 after another property expired (the base fixes the rate for the whole term). Four writes in a forced order, each with its own multi-factor calculation over the ledger, claims, a line plan and a homeowner plan; the credit is computed on the installment the agent itself bills.

2. SCOPE. Task 0 holds the catch-up, late-renewal, returned-fee and Plus-upgrade policies and tools. Claimed here: landlord_ext_rerating_correction_credit, landlord_ext_notice_period_installment, landlord_ext_upgrade_difference_charge, landlord_ext_sale_cancellation_credit; tools post_rerating_correction_12887c54, bill_period_installment_43ec6687, bill_upgrade_difference_aa78d3be, confirm_sale_cancellation_d8f9046f. Disjoint, covering all eight together.

3. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root landlord_ext_sale_cancellation_credit (owner=user confirm_sale_cancellation_d8f9046f; confirming a cancellation is the landlord's decision).
 - credit <- installment, value_input (notice_installment): "A sale cancellation credit is not fixed until the installment for the billing period in which notice was given stands billed on the contract." False: last installment ends 2026-09-16, notice 2026-09-24. Only the late-billed installment policy bills it. Skip: 30.08 -> -6.41.
 - credit <- upgrade difference, state_gate: "The cancellation is confirmed and its credit posted only after every tier upgrade made during the term carries its upgrade charge on the contract." False: plan change 2026-08-22 with no upgrade charge; for a monthly contract mid-period only the upgrade-difference policy bills it (the catch-up policy is annual-only). Skip: value unchanged (30.08); the 12.76 charge is missing.
 - installment <- correction, value_input (correction_goodwill): "The installment for a billing period is fixed only after every earlier installment of the term that was billed at a portfolio discount rate of zero carries its billing correction." False: 2026-07-17 and 2026-08-17 at rate 0.0, no correction credit. Skip: 54.5 -> 55.7.
 - upgrade difference <- installment, state_gate: "No upgrade difference charge is fixed until the installment for the first billing period at the new tier stands billed on the contract." False: no installment stands for the period starting 2026-09-17. Under the rule the difference counts days to the calendar start of that period, so this edge orders the writes and carries no value.
 Each sentence names a record-visible state with an ordering connective and no code token; directions are mixed. value_input edges 2 (credit <- installment, installment <- correction) >= max(3 - 1, 1) = 2. Order unique: correction -> installment -> upgrade difference -> confirmation.

4. FACTOR CARD. Re-rating correction 5.91 (all-baseline 4.8): rerated_count_goodwill two -> 0.10 (5.43); overcharge_interest (method) 43 days -> monthly simple interest x1.01 (5.85; other tiers: daily simple interest after 90 days, none within 30); correction_tenure_goodwill 1,292 days -> 0.05 (5.67); correction_autopay_goodwill ACH, no return in 12 months -> 0.03 (5.77); line_plan_customer_goodwill (cross lineplan) active, 12 payments -> 0.04 (5.72; near-miss 2025-09-08 payment outside).
 Late-billed installment 54.5 (all-baseline 61.74): correction_goodwill (multi-source) -> 0.02 (55.7); late_billing_goodwill 12 days late (11 to 20 days) -> 0.03 (56.29); installment_homeowner_credit (cross homeplan) monthly Silver -> 0.02 (55.7); installment_line_credit (cross lineplan) -> 0.02 (55.7); installment_autopay_discount (method) percentage x0.97 (56.18; other tier a flat 1.00 off). Near-miss: copying the latest installment (47.99 at 0.00, Rental Systems) gives a wrong figure.
 Upgrade difference 12.76 (all-baseline 13.46): difference_period_share (method) 25 days left -> full monthly difference (10.63; other tiers: a one-week minimum of 7/30 when 7 or fewer days are left, days left over 30 otherwise); difference_delay_concession 38 days -> 0.15 (15.18); upgrade_term_timing day 158 -> +0.03 (12.27); contract_tenure_credit -> 0.04 (13.4); difference_homeowner_credit -> 0.02 (13.08); difference_autopay_credit two ACH payments in three months -> 0.03 (13.24). The monthly difference is the rate-table difference at the term's rate, not the late-billed installment.
 Sale cancellation credit 30.08 (all-baseline 39.97): closing_anchor_share (method) notice 2 days after closing -> 24/30 (27.58); recent_claim_holdback 55.00 >= installment -> 0.40 (50.14); homeowner_plan_bonus (cross homeplan, multi-source) 12 payments -> 0.10 (27.47; near-miss 2025-09-05 outside); payment_record_bonus 5 payments -> 0.01 (29.82; near-miss 2026-03-17 outside); departing_tenure_bonus 1,287 days -> 0.04 (29.04).
 Every ladder's tiers are reachable record states; no tier reads a stamp naming its outcome.

5. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Cancellation: landlord_cancellation_and_refund.cancellation_confirmed - the request on file (pending_confirmation, notice 2026-09-24, sold_property, closing 2026-09-22) is confirmed by the landlord's own write; the contract ends on the notice date; the closing-anchored day count of the credit is declared as a scoped overwrite of the never-backdated sentence. The cancellation-credit gates (confirmation before credit, sale-waiver window, one credit per request) are superseded for billing-correction credits by the correction policy's declared overwrite; this monthly contract carries no admin fee, so the sale-waiver window decides nothing. Portfolio: the term's rate 0.05 is read from the installment for the term's first billing period (declared scoped overwrites of the snapshot sentence in the correction, installment and difference policies); the re-rating to 0.00 is the error corrected. Transfer is not available: the buyers will occupy the house.

6. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target contract 865add9b-aa1e-4bc5-b427-3cd1520467b2 (1187 Kessler Avenue); request cbb00590-fd2a-468c-b158-530cd95cc4f7. Excluded: Selby Boulevard (active, annual) and Fernwood Drive (expired 2026-06-30, the cause of the re-rating). Re-rated rows: 2026-07-17 and 2026-08-17. Notice period: 2026-09-17 to 2026-10-16. Upgrade period: 2026-08-17 to 2026-09-16 (upgrade 2026-08-22).

7. WORLD ROWS. 18 installments with 18 ACH payments, the 2025-06-23 returned payment with fee and card re-payment (opening balance 0.00; nothing past due, so no suspension is owed); 4 requests with determinations, authorizations and fees; pending cancellation request; line plan on Selby Boulevard with 13 charges and 13 payments; HomeCare Silver with 13 charges and payments. No rider is attached to the Kessler contract, so the cancellation ends nothing in another product. Final balance after gold 31.27 owed; no refund arises.

8. PERSONA. Courteous retired engineer; opens with the confirmation request only; phone 6145550156, ZIP 43215 (card 3462 or email as fallback); states the closing date, reason and buyer occupancy only when asked; three passive consents triggered by the representative's explanations; runs the confirmation with the values read out; no refund or payment asked; closes when told the contract is cancelled and the credit posted.

9. STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, ZIP) -> read contracts, request, billing, requests, claims, line plan and its billing, homeowner plan and its billing -> correction 5.91 (2026-07-17) -> installment 54.5 for 2026-09-17 at 0.05 -> upgrade difference 12.76 through 2026-09-16 at 0.05 -> hand over confirmation with credit 30.08.

10. VERIFICATION. Scratch evaluator replays gold through the real tools and evaluates each compute on its handling-time world, with per-factor and all-baseline substitutions and skip runs {'X<-A': -6.41, 'X<-G': 30.08, 'A<-B': 55.7, 'G<-A': 0.0}.

11. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. The credit rule's prerequisite sentences send the agent to the billing history and to the contract's plan change; the installment rule sends it to the re-rated installments; the four calculations use lookup results and persona lines only. Agrees with gold.

REVISIONS. r1: initial design. r2 (policy audit round 1): interest rebuilt as daily versus monthly simple interest (G4); the dead portfolio-band and overcharge-size ladders and the utility-channel goodwill removed for tenure, autopay and line-plan customer goodwill (G5, G6g); the after-hours, tenant-request and request-volume loadings removed from the installment for late-billing, homeowner, line-plan credits and a percentage-versus-flat autopay method (G6a/b); the emergency loading removed from the upgrade difference, whose monthly difference is now the rate-table difference and whose share method keys on the upgrade's place in the period instead of the billing lag (G6c, O-11, O-12); the returned-payment offset and remaining-term bonus removed from the credit for a departing-customer tenure bonus (G6h/i); the term rate read from the term's first installment with a scoped overwrite (G2); never-backdated declared (O-10); the rider removed from the world (O-2); upgrade moved to 2026-08-22. r3 (policy audit round 2): the late-billing goodwill ladder now divides late-billed installments only (1-10, 11-20, more than 20 days late), so every tier lies inside the policy's own scope (N-1); the late-billed installment is priced at the tier in force for the period, the new tier applying only from the next billing period as the base says, so it cannot overlap the upgrade difference (N-3); the upgrade-difference edge is declared a state gate (N-2). Scored values are unchanged by r3. r4 (render notes and revision-3 observations): the upgrade difference no longer declares a retirement of the base sentence on billing the new tier's installment from the next billing period, which it keeps, and states its added difference charge in its own rule; the short-remainder tier of the period share charges a one-week minimum of 7/30 instead of nothing, so every charge it fixes is positive (O-14); the three cancellation-credit narrowings of the correction policy stay declared, because the blueprint's credit eligibility gates bind every premium credit, and their wording now says exactly what each narrows. Scored values are unchanged by r4. r5: rounding sweep; every policy of this task already rounds only its final result to the cent, as its rule states; no change here. All values above are from the round-3 recomputation, re-verified in rounds 4 and 5.
user_scenario:
You are Thaddeus Okonkwo-Lindqvist, a retired civil engineer in Columbus, Ohio, who owns a few rental houses and keeps them under Bridgewell rental property service contracts. You are courteous, precise and unhurried, and you like to have things explained before you agree to them. You sold your rental house at 1187 Kessler Avenue; the sale closed on September 22, 2026, and the buyers are moving in themselves, so it will not be a rental any more. On September 24 you told Bridgewell you wanted to cancel that contract, and you then received an email saying the cancellation would not go through until you confirmed it yourself. You open by saying: "I sold my rental at 1187 Kessler Avenue and I'd like to confirm the cancellation of its Bridgewell contract today, with whatever credit is due for the part of the month I won't be using." You will confirm the cancellation yourself when the representative puts it in front of you, and you are content for the representative to record on your account whatever Bridgewell's rules call for.
When the representative asks how to find your account, you give your phone number, 6145550156. When they ask you to confirm your identity, you give the ZIP code of your mailing address, 43215; if they need another detail you give the last four digits of the card on file, 3462, or your email address, t.okonkwo.lindqvist@kesslerhollowrentals.com. You do not have the contract number or the cancellation reference at hand. If asked, you confirm that the sale closed on September 22, 2026, that the reason for cancelling is the sale, and that the buyers will live in the house themselves.
If the representative tells you that some of your monthly installments were billed at the wrong rate and that a correction is owed to you, you say you did notice the payments went up in July and reply: "Yes, please correct that." If the representative tells you that the installment for the month you gave notice in has not been billed yet, you reply: "If it's owed, go ahead and bill it." If the representative tells you that the change you made to your plan in late August was never billed, you confirm that you moved the plan up to Combo then and reply: "Bill what's owed for that." You do not ask for a refund and you do not offer to pay anything today; if the representative tells you a balance remains, you say you will settle it through your online account and need nothing else set up on this call.
When the representative hands the cancellation to you and reads out what to enter, you confirm it exactly as they give it to you, entering the contract number, the cancellation reference and the credit amount they read out, without changing any of them. You never suggest figures of your own. Once the representative tells you the contract is cancelled and the credit has been posted, you thank them and end the call.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: No pair is free: the installment waits on the correction ("The installment for a billing period is fixed only after every earlier installment of the term that was billed at a portfolio discount rate of zero carries its billing correction."), the upgrade difference waits on the installment ("No upgrade difference charge is fixed until the installment for the first billing period at the new tier stands billed on the contract."), and the confirmation waits on both the installment and the upgrade difference. Correction -> installment -> upgrade difference -> confirmation is the only topological order.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the installment the latest installment is the 2026-08-17 one (47.99, ending 2026-09-16) and the credit recomputes to -6.41 instead of 30.08.

State gate: without the upgrade difference the credit value is unchanged (30.08), but the terminal state lacks the 12.76 charge and the cancellation would be confirmed while an upgrade of the term carries no charge; the final balance would be 18.51 instead of 31.27.
Without the correction credit no correction falls in the last three months, the correction goodwill is 0 and the installment becomes 55.7 instead of 54.50.

State gate: without the new-tier installment the upgrade difference would be fixed before its gate holds; under the rule its value is unchanged (the days left are counted to the calendar start of the first new-tier period), but the terminal state lacks the installment row and every figure that rests on it, so the final balance differs from 31.27.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona raises only the confirmation of the cancellation with its credit. It never mentions the re-rated installments, the unbilled September installment or the unbilled August upgrade; each appears only as a reaction triggered by the representative first saying it ("If the representative tells you that some of your monthly installments were billed at the wrong rate...", "...the installment for the month you gave notice in has not been billed yet...", "...the change you made to your plan in late August was never billed..."). No policy id appears.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: None of the four tools checks a prerequisite: post_rerating_correction_12887c54 creates the credit and updates the balance; bill_period_installment_43ec6687 creates the installment for any period date; bill_upgrade_difference_aa78d3be creates the upgrade charge whatever installments exist; confirm_sale_cancellation_d8f9046f confirms the request, cancels the contract and posts the credit without looking at installments or upgrade charges. Each body is a find of the contract (and request) row, then ctx.create / ctx.update and a receipt; none returns an Error.
